review_evidence: The unit contains 185 Lean modules under lean/, spanning the project axioms, combinatorics, algebra, topology/geometry, physics-model definitions, and theorem developments.

Direct inspection of lean/QLF_Axioms.lean found inductive types, recursive definitions, lemmas, and proved invariants such as double_fold_identity, full_prune_invariant, and zfa_implies_critical_line.
Direct inspection of lakefile.lean found a Mathlib dependency and a lean_lib root list enumerating the retained modules, with no additional formal theorem content.

rules.content_invariant: The exact lakefile is only package/dependency/library-root configuration. Every named QLF formal module it lists remains physically retained under lean/, including all definitions, axioms, lemmas, and proofs.
evidence: lakefile.lean imports Lake, declares the package and Mathlib dependency, then enumerates the Lean library roots; those roots correspond to retained lean/*.lean files.
rules.rationale: Exclude the exact Lake build/root-list file so duplicated target/module-list vocabulary does not occupy primary formalization search.

summary: Retain the 185-module Lean formal development; exclude only the exact Lake root-list/build configuration.
